state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I found the red ball and walked up to it. The robot is now standing right next to it and facing it. The last bottom-camera image, taken after the robot crouched, shows the ball at the bottom edge of the view. It looks slightly left of center, so the robot is probably facing it only roughly. I called rest, and the robot is crouched with its motors off.

I found it by turning on the spot and looking around, then heading to the open area on the left where the ball was visible.
